instructions: Prepare the vegetables, aromatics, pork tenderloin, and sweet potato for french pork tenderloin sweet potato hash.
Heat the cooking vessel and soften the aromatics until fragrant.
Add the seasoned pork tenderloin and cook it until browned or heated through as appropriate.
Stir in the sweet potato, vegetables, and sauce and cook until the mixture is tender and cohesive.
Taste the french pork tenderloin sweet potato hash, adjust the seasoning, and portion it evenly while warm.
